verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity-management SaaS, so in-product AI insights are a fair axis. The evidence pack documents reporting, custom views and automated compliance error flags, but none of it mentions AI-generated insights or suggestions. Rule-based error flags and configurable reports are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
